body.name: Canonical embedded certificate \(E_{\mathbf B}\)
body.construction: Let \(\mathbf B=(B_1,\ldots,B_t)\) be any ordinary identifying collection for an instance in \(\mathfrak D_{\mathrm{AEK}}\). Acquire exactly one SELECT-RAND-READ protocol \(S_B\) for each distinct \(B\in\{B_1,\ldots,B_t\}\) and all labels in \(\Lambda_{\mathbf B}\). For every such \((B,b)\) and every canonically ordered labelled single-district factor of \(Q[V\setminus B](\cdot;b)=P_b(V\setminus B)\), include its protocol, label, and source masks. For each target factor \(C_j\), assign ownership to the lexicographically first included ordinary source and finite ancestor-district transcript schema that succeed uniformly over \(\Omega_j\), as guaranteed by the uniform-source theorem. Retain an empty-ownership record when needed to preserve each distinct paid protocol, merge equal records, and sort lexicographically. The resulting finite uniform certificate is \(E_{\mathbf B}\).
